links.outcome: Accuracy of biomarker-driven treatment recommendations with vs without retrieval grounding in curated knowledge base
links.effect: LLM-only achieved 62–75% accuracy; RAG-LLM achieved 79–91% with an unstructured database and 94–95% with a structured database.
links.quote: While LLM-only achieved 62–75% accuracy in biomarker-driven treatment recommendations, RAG-LLM achieved 79–91% accuracy with an unstructured database and 94–95% accuracy with a structured database.

unlisted_practices: Structured versus unstructured knowledge base format for retrieval augmentation

screen.practice: retrieval grounding with curated knowledge base
screen.reason: The study evaluates adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding with a structured knowledge base compared to a standard baseline LLM for oncology treatment recommendations.
